specific_sections.career_readiness: Display as a massive cinematic module. Use a radial progress chart (via Recharts or custom SVG) with the accent gradient stroke. The score itself must use JetBrains Mono in a large scale (text-6xl). Wrap in a pristine glassmorphic container.
specific_sections.portfolio_assembly: Editorial magazine layout. Break standard grids. Use overlapping images, large Cabinet Grotesk typography for project titles, and high-contrast tags. Do not use standard equal-height cards.
specific_sections.jobs_internships: Curated editorial listings, not a standard job board. Each listing is a massive horizontal row with py-12, border-b border-white/10. Use high-contrast hover states that dim siblings (group-hover focus).
specific_sections.employer_network: Cinematic candidate/employer profile views. Full-bleed dark imagery, bottom-up linear gradients for text legibility. Large, bold name typography with mono-spaced stats underneath.
specific_sections.aiah_coach: Minimalist, floating, or side-panel chat interface. Staggered Framer Motion entrances for messages. Use the provided abstract futuristic AI avatar. Messages from AIAH have a subtle gradient border.
specific_sections.sidebar_nav: Shared ecosystem navigation. Dark, minimal, utilizing Lucide icons with a 1px stroke. Active state features a 2px left-border glow using the primary gradient.
specific_sections.footer: Official ANCR footer. Massive py-32 border-t border-white/10. Use a large typographic 'ANCR™' logo and a strict, minimalist grid of links.

motion.page_transition: Initial opacity 0, y 20 -> opacity 1, y 0 (duration 0.6s, ease out)

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Recharts. Ensure you are using .js extensions (not .tsx).
Install 'lucide-react' for all iconography. Use 1px or 1.5px strokeWidth for an elegant look.
Use 'framer-motion' for all list staggers, tab changes, and micro-interactions.
Implement Shadcn UI components but entirely override their default Vercel/startup aesthetics. Make them brutalist and cinematic: border-white/10, bg-black, zero border radius (rounded-none).
The primary background color must strictly be obsidian black (#000000 to #050505). NO full-screen or large background gradients.
Use the Electric Blue -> Violet -> Magenta -> Orange gradient ONLY for highly specific highlights (e.g., the Readiness Score chart stroke, primary CTA hover state, or a subtle glowing border).
Typography MUST follow the exact mapping: Cabinet Grotesk for headings, Satoshi for body text, and JetBrains Mono for data/metrics. Include them via Google Fonts or standard imports in index.css.
Do not build a standard LinkedIn-style job board. Make it feel like an exclusive executive career center. Items must have excessive padding and huge typography.
Test all interactive elements and include data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts, uniform styling, or default shadows. Use asymmetric bento grids.
Create depth with layered design elements and explicit z-index hierarchy.
Use high-end glass-morphism effects with backdrop-blur-2xl and 1px white/10 borders.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Do NOT center align the app container. Text should naturally flow left-aligned.
Avoid pill-shaped buttons for this specific executive layout; use sharp edges (rounded-none) for a brutalist, cinematic editorial feel.
No AI emoji icons (🤖🧠💭). Use clean SVG icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical for an editorial feel (e.g., p-12, py-24).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Do not use complete transparent background in header or dropdown overlays; always use solid #050505 or glassmorphism (bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl).
